hero.title: Professional deep cleaning in South West London
hero.seo: End-of-tenancy, after-builders, one-off deep and regular cleaning in {{coverage}}.
hero.lede: Moving out, finishing renovation work, or living with a home that needs a full reset? {{business.owner}} plans each clean around the property’s condition, and agrees the scope and price with you before any work starts. Weekly and fortnightly cleaning is available too.
hero.note: Every quote is based on the property’s size, its condition and what you need done.
hero.caption: {{business.owner}}, owner of {{business.name}}

services.title: End of tenancy, after-builders, deep and regular cleaning
services.intro: One-off cleans and regular visits, each quoted individually. Not sure which fits? Describe the job and {{business.owner}} will advise.

results.title: Real cleaning. Real results.
results.intro: Before-and-after photos from {{business.owner}}’s own jobs. Drag the handle, or use the arrow keys, to compare.
results.galleryLink: See more photos in the gallery

gallery.description: Photos from {{business.owner}}’s own cleaning jobs across {{business.location}}: ovens, cooker hoods, kitchens, bathrooms and skirting boards, before and after.
gallery.title: Gallery of our cleaning work
gallery.intro: Photos from {{business.owner}}’s own jobs across {{business.location}}. Tap any photo to see it full size.

why.title: Why choose {{business.owner}}?
why.p1: Each clean is planned around the property’s condition and the scope you’ve agreed, not a generic checklist worked through against the clock.
why.h2: You know who is doing the work
why.p2: An owner-led, personal service, from your first message through to the finished clean.
why.p3: The scope and quote are agreed before booking, so you know exactly what’s included.

meet.title: Meet {{business.owner}}
meet.contact: When you get in touch, you’re talking to the person who plans your clean, agrees the scope and price with you, and is accountable for the result.

process.title: How it works
process.p1: The type of clean, property size, its condition, your postcode and a preferred date.
process.p2: The scope and price are confirmed before anything is booked.
process.p3: The date is confirmed and the clean is completed as agreed.
process.pricingTitle: A quote based on your property, not an arbitrary package
process.pricingText: Send the property size, its condition and the type of clean. {{business.owner}} will confirm what’s included and give you a clear price before you book.

reviews.title: What customers say
reviews.draft: Placeholder layout. No reviews are shown until genuine ones are added to site.config.json.
reviews.empty: Renata’s Google Business Profile is new, so there are no reviews on it yet. If she has cleaned for you, a few words about your experience would help others find her.

eco.title: Natural-based products, thorough results
eco.p1: All cleaning is done with products made with naturally derived ingredients, on every job and in every room. Tough jobs get more time and attention, not stronger chemicals.
eco.p2: Please let {{business.owner}} know about any allergies, sensitivities or pets before the clean.

areas.title: Deep cleaning across {{business.location}}
areas.intro: End-of-tenancy, after-builders, deep and regular cleans in {{business.locality}} and the surrounding areas, including:
areas.note: We also cover areas close to these. Not sure whether your postcode is covered? Send it with your enquiry and we’ll confirm.

faqs.title: Questions before you book
faqs.intro: Something not covered here? Message {{business.owner}} on WhatsApp, call {{business.phoneDisplay}} or email {{business.email}}.

quote.title: Tell {{business.owner}} what needs cleaning
quote.intro: Share a few details about the property. {{business.owner}} will reply to confirm the scope and a clear price. Nothing is booked until you agree.
quote.waText: Want a quicker quote? Send a few photos of the property on WhatsApp.

form.name: Your name
form.contactHint: A phone number, an email address, or both.
form.detailsHint: Size and condition of the property, and any dates. For example: 2-bed flat, heavy limescale in the shower, checkout on Friday.

form.photosHint: Photos help give an accurate quote. After you send this form, a button opens a WhatsApp chat with Renata, with a copy of your enquiry ready to go. Just add your photos and send.
form.privacy: Read how we use your details in our privacy notice.

footer.ctaText: Tell {{business.owner}} about the property and get a clear price before you book.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How {{business.name}} uses the details you send through the quote form.
privacy.intro: This notice explains how {{business.name}} uses the details you give us when you ask for a quote.
privacy.collectList:
• Your name and the phone number and/or email address you give us
  • The postcode of the property
  • The service you need and your description of the job, including any dates you mention
  • Whether you’d like to send photos on WhatsApp (photos themselves are sent through WhatsApp, not this form)
privacy.whatsapp: If you message us on WhatsApp instead, your messages and photos are also handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy.
privacy.why: Only to reply to your enquiry, prepare a quote and, if you go ahead, arrange the clean. The lawful basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract.
privacy.receive: The quote form is delivered to us by {{form.processor}}, which processes it on our behalf.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you by contacting us using the details above. If you’re unhappy with how we’ve handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.
privacy.receiveFallback: We don’t sell your details or share them for marketing. They’re only shared with service providers that help us receive and manage enquiries, such as our email provider.
privacy.keepFallback: We keep your details only for as long as we need them to reply to your enquiry and, if you book, to provide the clean and keep the records the law requires. Details from enquiries that don’t lead to a booking are deleted once they’re no longer needed.
